description: Combine a UTF-16 high surrogate and low surrogate into a code point (Py_UNICODE_JOIN_SURROGATES)
notes: CPython 3.13.0, Py_UNICODE_JOIN_SURROGATES (Include/cpython/unicodeobject.h), with Py_UCS4 as uint32_t. The two asserts that check the surrogate ranges are dropped, as in release (NDEBUG) builds, so the inputs are arbitrary. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: shl, two and, or disjoint and add: 6 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
